title: wolfSSL 5.9.1 -> 5.9.4
description: ML-DSA API is now wc_MlDsaKey_* (wc_dilithium_* are macros) and needs C wrappers in wolfcrypt-rs. WC_RNG grew from 40 to 96 bytes. dilithium.c is now wc_mldsa.c and mlkem.h is now wc_mlkem.h. Stale sp_521 patch overlay removed (fixed upstream). wolfSSL 5.9.4 now rejects signing a zero hash, so link_probe_pk uses a non-zero digest. wolfcrypt-wrapper silently lost ML-DSA (build.rs probed wc_dilithium_init); ported upstream b6d9623 (dilithium -> mldsa).
close_reason: Done in 76eb106, 84a7995, 0acf145, b502697 and 846dba9. A cfg diff between 5.9.1 and 5.9.4 showed nothing else lost.
